title: Hearty Monsoon Stew
description: A flavorful and comforting stew originating from the monsoon regions, perfect for a cold evening. Hearty Monsoon Stew is a rich and savory dish that will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion, garlic, ginger, and a pinch of the smoked paprika. Cook until the vegetables are softened.
Add the Monsoon Stew Mix and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped carrots, celery, and potatoes. Stir to combine.
Add the water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
